name: System maintenance
desc: Disk, journal size, pending updates, reboot needed, failed services. Proposes a journal vacuum and dangling-image cleanup.
prompt: For each selected host: check disk use (host.disk_usage), journal size (journal.disk_usage), pending updates (updates.list where available), whether a reboot is pending (host.reboot_required: exit code 0 means yes), and failed services (get_services with the host). If the journal is larger than 1 GB, propose journal.vacuum with days 14. If Docker has dangling images, propose docker.prune_dangling_images. Never reboot or update anything. Finish with a short per-host report.
